spark_open.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal chimera shown in right-facing profile standing on a light ground. It has the head, hooked beak, eye and feathered wings of a raptor joined to the torso, four limbs, paws and long tufted tail of a big cat. The front half including the head, neck, chest and wings is covered in dense overlapping golden-brown to dark brown feathers, while the hindquarters, belly and legs are covered in short tawny-brown fur with a paler underbelly. Two very large wings are raised and spread outward from the upper back. The overall coloration is warm browns, tans and cream with darker brown-black feather edges and a dark tuft at the tip of the tail.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged creature shown in right profile standing on a plain background. The front has the head, hooked beak, eye, and densely feathered neck and chest of a large eagle, with two large feathered wings raised and spread on its upper back. The middle to rear has the tawny-furred muscular torso, four sturdy legs with large paws, and long slender tuft-tipped tail of a large cat. The feathered front transitions into fur at the shoulders and chest.
